digest.component_or_area: tickets repository storage / reconciler state persistence
propositions: The committed .bridge_state cache on the tickets branch consumes 1.04 GiB (92% of branch size), driven by timestamp and rotation bookkeeping fields that are never read in src/

Scattered edits to the 18 MB bindings.json file across commits defeat git delta compression, resulting in 12.79 KB marginal pack cost per version, reducible to 1.74 KB by removing timestamps and moving rotation bookkeeping
The reconciler runs on ephemeral runners so durable state must live in git; the solution is to make the cache cheap via content reduction rather than re-homing it off-branch

A history-strip operation using git fast-export/fast-import can reduce the repository from 1.17 GB to 98 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and restoring byte-identical HEAD tree via dynamic re-add

Implementation requires five coordinated changes: delete baseline_advanced_at, move last_get_pass to a sidecar file with mixed-version reads, normalize baseline text fields, narrow prev_snapshot.json to key-set, and suppress empty mutations
